# Codex SEO

> Codex-first SEO skill suite for technical SEO, content quality, schema, Core Web Vitals, GEO/AEO, local SEO, maps, backlinks, DataForSEO, Google APIs, Firecrawl, and Gemini image workflows.

## Project

- Repository: https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/codex-seo
- License: MIT
- Current version: 1.9.6+codex.1
- Canonical skill entrypoint: skills/seo/SKILL.md
- Plugin manifest: .codex-plugin/plugin.json

## Install

- Private preview: `gh repo clone AgriciDaniel/codex-seo && cd codex-seo && bash install.sh`
- Future public install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgriciDaniel/codex-seo/main/install.sh | bash`
- Windows private preview: `gh repo clone AgriciDaniel/codex-seo; cd codex-seo; powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1`

## Runtime Notes

- New config path: `~/.config/codex-seo/`
- New cache path: `~/.cache/codex-seo/`
- Project cache path: `.seo-cache/`
- Credentials must stay outside the repository.
- Optional live-data providers return setup-required states when credentials or MCP servers are unavailable.

## Common Prompts

- `Do a full SEO check on https://example.com following best practices.`
- `/seo audit https://example.com`
- `/seo technical https://example.com`
- `/seo schema https://example.com`
- `/seo dataforseo serp "seo tools"`
